summary: Saving a photo and a video in My AI Artwork › Recent each logs the Mixpanel event Artwork_Result_Save with tab Recent, plus GenAI_Result_Save or ImageToVideo_Result_Save.
After Reuse the Custom page shows the toast 「Settings applied」 for about two seconds, with Kling 2.6, 10s, Pro, Sound Off and the prompt applied.
Both ‹ and system Back in the room opened by Reuse return to the video's Save & Share page.
Tapping Reuse logs ImageToVideo_Reuse_Click with model Model_Kling-2.6, and Artwork_Reuse_Click is no longer sent.
